title: Review Driver Earnings Each Week
summary: Combine the weekly Uber and Bolt exports into one summary per driver, and keep a list of documents due to expire.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you run a small fleet on Uber and Bolt; the value is less time spent combining exports.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: One summary replaces two platform exports to check.
Expiring licences and insurance are caught early.
who_its_for: Operators running a small rideshare fleet.
